title: Sovra Phase 13 Domain Schemas (FTF-1301 — CostProfile rate card)
description: Frozen shared domain schemas for the organization-scoped CostProfile rate-card resource (Section 28/31/32/45/64/69-70/77/81). Field constraints (patterns, lengths, enums) are copied verbatim from the single real enforcing source, apps/api/app/costs/cost_profile_schema.py, and tested against it directly in tests/tasks/test_ftf_1301.py so this file cannot silently drift from the code that actually validates these shapes. DisqualifiedReason's three real values are exactly the three conditions apps/api/app/costs/cost_profile_schema.py::is_certifiable_cheapest checks, in the same order — this task's own negative_acceptance ('Token price zero is not local compute free; unverified/expired rate cannot certify cheapest') made real and testable.

Currency.description: A real ISO-4217 code from apps/api/app/budget/budget_policy_schema.py::ALLOWED_CURRENCIES (FTF-0403), reused directly rather than a second, duplicate currency vocabulary.

Source.description: Where this dated rate came from (a provider pricing-page URL, or a description of the local TCO worksheet it was computed from). Required and non-empty — Section 32/69.3's own 'no guessed performance or cost values' rule, applied to this record's own provenance.

DisqualifiedReason.description: Why a profile is not currently certifiable_cheapest — null only when certifiable_cheapest is true. Never omitted: 'display unknowns honestly.'

CostProfileCreateRequest.description: The create request body. rate_amount always arrives as a decimal string, never a bare JSON number (Section 6's own 'money uses Decimal + currency' rule).

CostProfile.description: Section 28/31/32/45/64/69-70/77/81 — one dated, sourced, immutable rate observation. Only verified_at/row_version/updated_at ever change after creation (apps/api/app/costs/cost_profile_crud.py::verify_cost_profile) — a new dated observation is always a new row, never an edit of an old one.

CostProfileSearchResult.description: A CostProfile as returned by the /costs/cost-per-success/search endpoint, annotated with this task's own negative_acceptance verdict.
